inputs.goal: Иду к врачу с ребёнком, болит спина. Первый раз в местной клинике, боюсь не понять назначения

existing_scenes.title: Регистратура
must_say: give your name — slot: the name
say who the appointment is for — slot: the person
answer whether you have been here before — slot: the last visit (never, before)
give the document you have — slot: the document
ask where to wait — slot: none
ask how long the wait is — slot: none

existing_scenes.title: Приём у врача
must_say: say where it hurts — slot: the part of the body
say when it started — slot: the time expression
say what makes it worse — slot: the movement or activity
answer whether there were other symptoms — slot: the symptom
ask what a word means — slot: the word
ask whether an activity is allowed — slot: the activity
ask how often to give something — slot: the medicine
confirm you understand the instruction — slot: the instruction

existing_scenes.title: Аптека
must_say: say what medicine you need — slot: the medicine
say who the medicine is for — slot: the person
ask whether this medicine is available — slot: the medicine
ask how to give it — slot: the medicine
ask whether there are side effects — slot: the medicine
ask whether you need anything else — slot: the item
confirm the amount you need to pay — slot: the amount

findings.detail: scene 5: must_say 3 «ask what the result means» — slot «the result or term» is what the answer names (result)

scenes.topic_description:
Situation: You return to the same clinic after the first visit because your child still has back pain or the treatment has not helped enough. This scene covers what happens when the doctor reviews progress and decides on the next step after the initial consultation.
Learner: Parent. Partner: Doctor.
Not in this scene: registration details, first description of symptoms, understanding the original instructions, buying medicine at the pharmacy.
must_say: say that the medicine is not helping — slot: the medicine
say what problem continues — slot: the symptom or pain
answer whether the problem is better or worse — slot: the change
ask whether you should continue something — slot: the medicine or treatment
ask whether you need another visit — slot: none
ask whether you need a test — slot: the test
confirm when to come back — slot: the time
must_understand: asks whether the medicine helped at all
asks whether the problem is better, worse, or the same
says you should continue, stop, or change the treatment
explains whether a test or another visit is needed
tells you when to come back if the problem continues

scenes.topic_description:
Situation: After the first appointment, the doctor has ordered a test or review, and you are back at the clinic to hear the results and learn the next step. It is still your first course of care in the local clinic, and understanding the outcome matters.
Learner: Parent. Partner: Doctor.
Not in this scene: front desk check-in, describing the pain from the start, medicine instructions from the first visit, paying for or collecting medicine.
must_say: say you are here for test results — slot: the test
ask whether the results are normal — slot: the results
ask what the result means — slot: the result or term
ask what happens next — slot: none
ask whether you need a referral — slot: the specialist or service
answer when you can come — slot: the day or time
confirm where to go next — slot: the place
must_understand: says the results are ready
explains whether the results are normal or not
says what the result means for the problem
offers the next step: another visit, a test, or a referral
tells you where to go and when
